title: MESC Open House
description:
The fall quarter is almost here, which means MESC Welcome Week is right around the corner! We can’t wait to start the year with a week full of community, connection, and fun for both new and returning students, staff, and faculty💛

First up: MESC Open House on Monday, September 28th! Enjoy SWANA desserts from @hasnas_sweets , coffee & tea from @qamaria_riverside , SWANA jeopardy, raffles, and more. Plus, learn more about MESC resources, upcoming events, and ways to get involved!

We’re so excited to see you🥳

title: McNair Scholars Program First Review Date
description:
Thinking about pursuing a Ph.D. after college? 🎓✨

Recruitment for the UCR McNair Scholars Program is officially OPEN! The @ucrmcnair prepares undergraduate students for doctoral studies through faculty-mentored research opportunities, graduate school prep, and hands-on application assistance.

✨ Program Highlights ✨ 

✔️ Summer Stipend — Earn up to $2,800 during our 5-week summer research program!

✔️ Mentorship — Work directly with faculty on research.

✔️ Grad School Prep — Full support through the graduate application process.

⬇️ Important Details

📅 First Review Date: October 23

📲 How to Apply: Scan the QR code in the flyer or visit the link in our bio to start your application!

📧 Questions? Contact us at mcnair@ucr.edu

#UCR #UCRiverside #McNairScholars #UndergradResearch #UCRStudents
